english.title: Aid, abet counsel and procure the making / cause making of a false entry / record on a tachograph
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), aided, abetted, counselled and procured **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to

(A)_[make]_
(B)_[cause to be made]_

a record or entry on a record sheet kept or carried for the purposes of the Community Recording Equipment Regulation or section 97 of the Transport Act 1968 which

(C)_[he]_
(D)_[she]_

knew to be false in that **(..SPECIFY FALSIFICATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 99(5)of the Transport Act 1968 and section 8 of the Accessories and Abettors Act 1861.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Where the place of offence is uncertain, see section 103(7) of the Act, which provides that the offence may be treated as having been committed at the place of driving, place of residence of the driver or employer's principal place of business.
(ii) Section 97(7) defines the "Community Recording Equipment Regulation" as Council Regulation (EEC ) No. 3821/85, as amended.
